title.narrative: Designing GGGI global pre-readiness Loss and Damage programme and enhancing knowledge partnership

description.narrative: The project aims to conduct initial works to create a robust GGGI Loss and Damage (L&D) readiness program by providing GGGI staff and member countries with enhanced tools and capacity to address and manage climate-related losses and damages, ultimately protecting their economies, infrastructure, and social well-being, while positioning GGGI as a leader in implementing loss and damage preparedness programs. Through the gaps and needs assessment the definition of mitigation, adaptation and L&D support will be identified for each country.
